description: This portrait depicts Isabella Wolff, one of Sir Thomas Lawrence’s closest friends. Shown contemplating a printed image of the Delphic Sibyl from Michelangelo's Sistine Chapel ceiling, Wolff assumes a pose that cleverly echoes another Sibyl from that same work. Sibyls, priestesses of Classical legend who made enigmatic judgments and prophecies, were often pictured according to Western fantasies of the Near East, hence Wolff’s elaborate turban.
title: Isabella Wolff
